svg.aria-label: Five-hour window utilisation from 0 to 100 percent. A review and verify band spans the whole window, admitted at every reading. Implementation work is admitted from 0 to 80 percent; the reserve owns the 80 to 92 percent band where the budget gate does not hold; from 92 percent the budget gate holds every dispatch. A dashed marker at 85 percent names this node's pair: implementation refused, review admitted. A panel below states that an unreadable window is not an empty one: with no reading, implementation is refused against the reserved fraction and review and verify are admitted.
svg.text: 85% — this node's pair: implementation refused · review admitted
review / verify — admitted at every reading; the reserve is never withheld from a bookend
0–80%: the reserved fraction is gone before any work is dispatched, at every utilisation.
80–92%: the reserve refuses implementation while the budget gate does not hold — the band this node's pair is driven in.
92–100%: the budget gate holds every dispatch; the reserve's refusal is not the operative one there.
An unreadable window is not an empty one — absent is not 0%.
With no reading at all, implementation is refused against the 20% reserve, naming the role and the fraction,
and review / verify are admitted. Folding the missing reading to zero would have admitted everything.
